description: This file defines the Layout controller class for the admin section of an OpenCart-based e-commerce platform. It manages layout listing, creation, editing, saving, and deletion functionalities, including handling associated modules, routes, and permissions.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: Controller class for managing layout operations in the admin panel, including listing, editing, creating, saving, and deleting layouts.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that loads the layout list view with necessary data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of layouts by calling getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares layout data, including pagination, sorting, and links, then renders the layout list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a layout, including loading associated modules, routes, and extension data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing layout, including validation and permission checks, returning JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected layouts after validation, checking for dependencies and permissions, returning JSON response.
